title: Make tool effects idempotent
prompt: Implement an idempotent MOCK effect where both the effect counter and dedup result live in the SAME SQLite transaction. Repeated key+canonical JSON arguments returns prior result; changed arguments with the same key raise. Return counter value after effect. This atomic local service does not prove exactly-once behavior for an unrelated remote API.
